With the ridge mapper at its selected k (k = 20), Llama 3.1 8B→70B transfer reaches **57.78% on MMLU** and **14.78% on GSM8K** (Table 13, p. 18).

- **Selected k:** The paper picks one k per pair, the value that gives the highest mean accuracy on ARC-C, HellaSwag, WinoGrande and MMLU. GSM8K is not used in that choice (p. 6). For Llama 3.1 8B→70B the selected k is 20 (Table 1, p. 6; Table 13, p. 18).
- **Compared with the 70B model alone:** The 70B target scores 78.84% on MMLU and 81.12% on GSM8K by itself (p. 18). That means the transfer keeps **73.3%** of the target's MMLU accuracy but only **18.2%** of its GSM8K accuracy (Table 1, p. 6).
- **Compared with the 8B model alone:** Both transfer scores are below the 8B source model's own results of 64.97% on MMLU and 56.10% on GSM8K (p. 18).
